turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I'm told you gave my son a zero. Why am I only hearing about this now?
Funny? Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? My son doesn't lie, and I'm not here to be insulted. What do you actually have on that essay?
Owen's essay. What do you have?
